purpose: Documented map from the 27 master's BPA actuators (Solid_Models/OpenSim/Gait2392_Robotbody/bpa_actuators_27.json) to (a) STOCK right-side gait2392 human muscles or functional groups for the meet-or-beat torque targets and (b) robot-side seed routes in gait2392_robotbody.osim. Every decision is grounded in the master's own MIF values: each master MIF either equals a single stock muscle MIF exactly or equals a group sum exactly (verified 2026-10-03 by tmp/routing_opt/list_stock_mif.py against gait2392_simbody.osim). Human targets are ALWAYS computed from stock gait2392_simbody.osim muscles on their STOCK routes, never from muscles routed on robot paths (the prior attempt's bug; Ben's doctrine in add_mag3_r_torque_verdict_20260926.md).

conventions.primary_dof: The OpenSim coordinate whose torque curve is the meet-or-beat target. Chosen from the master actuator's function and section (its axis codes name the distal z output). Secondary crossed DOFs are recorded as info curves but do not enter the campaign objective (documented scope decision).
conventions.rom_deg: Campaign RoM for the primary DOF, in degrees. hip/knee/ankle/subtalar follow the committed biPulleySpecsFromOpenSim.jointRange table; mtp and lumbar read from the stock model coordinate ranges at generation time.
conventions.robot_seed_preference: Ordered robotbody muscle names whose route seeds the BPA optimization for that actuator. routingSpecsFromRobotbody takes the first that resolves to a well-formed spec and logs which one won. appliesForce flags in robotbody are ignored (the campaign re-enables the routes it uses; the flags belong to Connor's analysis, documented).
conventions.human_group: Stock muscles summed elementwise (arm x MIF) on the shared angle grid to form the group target curve.
conventions.one_side: The right side is optimized; the left is its mirror (Ben's requirement). All inter-actuator spacing and footprint checks therefore consider each routed set once.

group_sum_exact: AMMIF 2268 = add_mag1 381 + add_mag2 343 + add_mag3 488 + add_long 627 + add_brev 429
judgment_calls: Gluteus Maximus actuator (GMMIF 5047 N): mapped to ALL nine gluteal compartments (glut_max1-3, glut_med1-3, glut_min1-3, sum 4867 N). Ben's example names 'gluteus minimus 1 + medius 1 + maximus 1'; the three-'1'-compartment sum is 1662 N, only a third of the master's 5047 N BPA sizing, while all-nine is 4867 N (3.7 percent under). Following the VasMIF exact-sum pattern (named for one member, sized for the group), the group reading is taken.
Tibialis Posterior actuator 15 (TPMIF 3549 N): 3549 is soleus's MIF, a copy-paste artifact; the target is tib_post_r (1588 N) regardless of the BPA sizing.

Tibialis Posterior actuator 16 (TAMIF 905 N): the duplicate name is a legacy copy-paste bug; its section comment ('Tibialis Anterior t2 -> a3') and the exact 905 N match identify it as tib_ant_r. Primary DOF ankle (the extraction note says its route crosses the ankle only), subtalar recorded as secondary.

rom_notes: hip flexion/knee/ankle/subtalar follow the committed biPulleySpecsFromOpenSim.jointRange table. hip_adduction_r and hip_rotation_r follow the master's own Add_Mag_Mesh_Opt.m convention (lines 30-40: adduction [-45, 20] deg, rotation [-45, 40] deg). mtp_angle_r, lumbar_extension, lumbar_bending, and lumbar_rotation carry EMPTY range_min/range_max in BOTH stock gait2392_simbody.osim and gait2392_robotbody.osim (verified 2026-10-03), so the campaign sets explicit judgment values: mtp [-40, 40] deg, lumbar_extension [-20, 15] deg, lumbar bending/rotation [-15, 15] deg. Ben's standing rule this round: conflicts are resolved by a documented choice, never silently.
